notes:
Rabta is now about half the size to download.

Rabta 2.0 brings a new look with themes (NOVA, Ocean, Royal, Emerald or your own colour) and a new icon.
Chats show online and last seen, delivery ticks, an emoji and sticker panel, and a new attach menu with your recent photos.
Status: add text, drawings, stickers and captions, and see who viewed it.
Profile photo: view full screen, crop or change it; it comes back after you sign in again.
Videos are made smaller before sending.
Rabta tells you when an update is ready.
